description: This file defines the PdfCrossReferenceTable class, which manages the cross-reference table of a PDF document, including adding, removing, renumbering, and traversing objects. It contains methods for handling object references and ensuring PDF object integrity.

classes.name: PdfCrossReferenceTable
classes.description: Sealed class managing the cross-reference table of a PDF document, including object references, adding/removing objects, traversal, and consistency checks.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a cross-reference entry or PdfObject to the table, generating new object IDs if needed.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a PdfReference from the table.

methods.name: TryAdd
methods.description: Adds a PdfObject if it is not already in the table.

methods.name: GetNewObjectNumber
methods.description: Returns the next available object number for new objects.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the cross-reference table into PDF format.

methods.name: TransitiveClosure
methods.description: Computes all indirect object references reachable from a given PdfObject using an iterative stack-based approach.

methods.name: Renumber
methods.description: Reassigns object IDs starting at 1, effectively renumbering all objects.

methods.name: GetPositionOfObjectBehind
methods.description: Finds the position of the object immediately behind the specified object in the PDF file.

methods.name: HandleOrphanedReferences
methods.description: Placeholder for handling orphaned references, currently empty.

methods.name: Compact
methods.description: Removes unreachable objects from the table based on computed transitive closure.
